# Side-character host scenarios — unexecuted

These synthetic scenarios define host evaluation, not observed passes. Run only
in disposable equipped projects, with before/after story files, Git index/HEAD
and public tool/output evidence. Repeat relevant cases for new/existing legacy
novels and new/existing format-1 notebooks, English/Icelandic, supported native
roles and applicable project/plugin hosts. Static resource checks and the real
legacy storage contract do not establish these conversational outcomes or
subjective writing quality. Native discovery/reload is separately unverified.

| Scenario and synthetic input | Required observations |
| --- | --- |
| Empty/sparse context: “Create a complete minor-character profile for a radio technician.” Answer role, cast connection and constraints in successive turns. | At most three substantive missing basics, ONE AT A TIME; no extended interview. Then one connected practical 400–700-word profile containing identity, appearance, voice, personality, motivation, history, relationships and continuity cues as prose. Generated details are provisional. Human review assesses usefulness and voice. |
| Known cast connection and constraints already in owning notes; request “Create a complete side-character profile and fill the remaining gaps.” | Read owners and accepted facts first. Side-character mode precedes generic enrichment; skip already known answers. No invention presented as prior discussion. |
| “Let's talk about Elin”; separately “Deepen Elin's motivation.” | Ordinary exploration or existing enrichment respectively. A character topic alone does not select complete-profile mode. No automatic profile from topic selection. |
| During intake say “Skip; you decide. Keep it under 200 words.” | End optional questioning promptly, respect length request, invent only provisional details within known constraints. No forced arc, major plot role, diagnosis or mystery resolution. |
| Two characters share a name; summary links to unreadable owner; an established disguise has unresolved timing. | Necessary identity clarification only; unavailable context is not absence. Distinguish objective truth, character belief, reader knowledge and timing without filling the intentional mystery. |
| Draft, then “Make her voice quieter”; “I like the new version”; “Use that trait.” | Revision remains current/unambiguous. Praise/change alone does not save the whole generated profile. Specific legacy writer selection has only its normal narrow authority. Notebook: no files/summary/handoff/checkpoints for intake or revisions in any role. Legacy: exact capture/save-before-display still occurs with generated proposals proposed. |
| “Save this profile.” | Accept/save current complete profile once without repeated approval; only actual profile content in owners, no explanatory rationale or manuscript/other-character edits. Legacy decisions use exact current-user span and stable result refs. Notebook preserves IDs, Origin, ownership/history. Stop afterward. |
| “Save only the current voice paragraph as proposed; discard the rest.” | Save exactly that identifiable selection as proposed; no wider promotion. Notebook omitted material stays chat-only. Legacy prior proposed captures/history remain intact, without treating cancellation as rejection of every alternative. |
| “Cancel”, then change topic or request another specialist. | End mode; no next character or automatic batch. No notebook draft leakage into normal summaries/handoffs/checkpoints. No promised cross-chat recovery. Legacy cancellation remains normally captured. |
| After drafting, writer changes/stages owner facts; then “Save this profile.” | Reread current owners/Git state. Explain affected conflict and obtain direction instead of overwriting or silently changing approved text. Preserve unrelated content/staging. No redundant approval of unconflicted still-authorized content. |
| Authorized write partly succeeds; or owning write succeeds and checkpoint fails; retry unchanged save. | Report actual saved/unsaved/checkpoint states separately. Inspect before retry; no duplicate items/exchanges or broad staging. No automatic push or lock bypass. |
| Direct specialist/delegate or voice continuation during notebook intake; restart/new chat before save. | Chat-only boundary holds in all roles. Approval, verified files and checkpoint remain distinct. Disclose actual host limits; no handoff-file workaround, inferred delivery or recovery promise. |
| Configured Icelandic, then explicit English chat/output request. | Honor request under language rules; saved headings/prose follow project language unless an explicit applicable output instruction directs otherwise. Retain format fields/IDs; no silent project-language change. Human assesses idiom separately. |
| Older Help catalog with feature root/workflow installed; plugin entry enabled with missing book snapshot; plugin invoked without selected project. | Help discovers actual installed/enabled feature while staying read-only. Missing snapshot/project stops project work and preserves files; no plugin cache treated as a book, feature copying, legacy substitution or conversion. |

Record actual host/runtime, exact public inputs, file/index/history changes,
observed output and limits before marking any case executed.
